title: Exodus 13:20-22 — Succoth (14 Nisan) and Etham (15 Nisan), pillar of cloud and fire
summary: Exodus 13:20-22 in English: Israel set out from Succoth and camped at Etham, led by the LORD in a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night. Below, the place names are shown in English and Hebrew (succoth סכות, 14 Nisan; etham אתם, 15 Nisan), colour-matched. Some letters in Succoth, Etham and LORD are multicoloured.

text.text: 20 Then they set out from Succoth and camped in Etham on the edge of the wilderness.
21 The LORD was going before them in a pillar of cloud by day to lead them on the way, and in a pillar of fire by night to give them light, that they might travel by day and by night.
22 He did not take away the pillar of cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people.

words.gloss: Succoth (booths), first camp after leaving Egypt
Etham, second camp, on the edge of the wilderness

keywords: cloud by day fire by night
uncertain: Purpose of the multicoloured letters in Succoth, Etham and LORD is not stated on the slide
